Looking at the error messages, the issue is with the edge label syntax on lines 13 and 14:

```
edge branch -[Primary WAN]-- hubprimary
edge branch -[Backup WAN]-- hubbackup
```

The parser is interpreting `-[Primary WAN]--` as the operator itself, leaving no target ID to follow. In FigDown, labels must be quoted strings placed **after** the target, not embedded in the operator.

The corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 topology
title "Branch office WAN uplinks"

node access1 "Access Switch 1"
node access2 "Access Switch 2"
node branch "Branch Router"
node hubprimary "Regional Hub (Primary)"
node hubbackup "Regional Hub (Backup)"

edge access1 -- branch
edge access2 -- branch
edge branch -- hubprimary "Primary WAN"
edge branch -- hubbackup "Backup WAN"
```

The key changes:
- **Line 13:** `edge branch -- hubprimary "Primary WAN"` — label moves outside the operator, properly quoted
- **Line 14:** `edge branch -- hubbackup "Backup WAN"` — same correction

This follows FigDown's rule that every label is quoted and whitespace separates arguments, so labels come as separate quoted strings after the target node ID.
